ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a contiguous high-intensity white field. Low-intensity black banding is restricted to the trailing edge and distal tips. Small, isolated low-intensity focal spots are visible in the mid-inner region of the left lobe and near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex trailing edges tapering to pointed distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint yellowish-brown pixel cluster (diatom film or light scarring) visible around the central median notch and peduncle insertion area.
